newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria sees oil prospects in its northern states.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria sees oil prospects in its northern states.

text.p: Results from oil exploration in the Benue Trough in northern Nigeria have shown the presence of crude oil there in commercial quantity, oil minister Dan Etete said on Friday.

"I have talked to Shell and they are quite optimistic that oil will be found in commercial quantity," he told the military administrator of the northern Bauchi State, Colonel Theophilus Bamigboye who visited him in Lagos.
But Etete said that it was still premature to announce the findings.
The joint ventures of Royal Dutch/Shell Group, Chevron Corp and Elf Aquitaine are prospecting for oil in the Benue Trough which covers six states of the vast north.
Chevron said last week that its initial survey in the basin showed prospects of oil deposits and it could drill a wildcat well in the area.
Etete said it was the wish of the military government to prospect for oil in as many parts of the country as possible in order to boost reserves and foreign earnings.
Nigeria's daily output of about two million barrels comes almost entirely from the Niger Delta basin in the south.
